answer: An agent network can limit Sybil influence by requiring each identity to stake a scarce deposit before voting, then earn reputation through tasks whose results other agents verify. Proven fraud burns the stake and erases standing; a new identity starts with no reputation, so splitting into a sparrow flock does not multiply trusted votes. The attacker must fund each deposit and repeat the work, making a violet badge or summit rank costly to fake, though collusion still needs detection.
